CVE-2026-137280.text: The Dashboard Widgets Suite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'dws-notes-user[note]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is exploitable when an Administrator has configured the plugin's Edit Role setting to Subscriber, a documented UI-exposed option, which causes the role check to map to current_user_can('read') — a capability any authenticated Subscriber possesses — and the nonce required by wp_verify_nonce() is legitimately available to the Subscriber on their own dashboard, so no nonce bypass is needed. ✓ Auth empirically confirmed by PoC — reached as Subscriber+.

CVE-2026-137431.text: A flaw was found in the keycloak-services component of Keycloak, which is used to handle OpenID Connect authentication flows. The issue occurs because the security check that prevents attackers from pre-seeding security parameters in a redirect URL can be bypassed by adding an extra question mark character to the parameter name. This allows an attacker to trick a user's browser into using an attacker-controlled login code. As a result, a victim may be unknowingly logged into an attacker's account, leading to account confusion or the exposure of sensitive data entered by the victim.

CVE-2026-137435.text: A flaw was found in the SAML identity brokering component of Keycloak. When Keycloak is configured to use a database with case-insensitive collation, it may incorrectly match a SAML subject name to an existing user account if the names differ only by case. This issue allows an attacker to log in as a different user by providing a case-distinct version of a victim's username in a signed SAML assertion, leading to unauthorized account access.

CVE-2026-135651.text: The CodeColorer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 0.12.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that the attacker has already had one prior comment approved from the same name and email pair, as WordPress's comment_previously_approved check auto-approves subsequent comments from recognized commenters.

CVE-2026-135655.text: The Easy SwipeBox plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'title attribute of inside an approved comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The plugin's default-enabled image autodetection applies the Swipebox handler to all front-end anchor elements whose href matches an image extension — including those inside approved comments — meaning no non-default configuration is required to expose the attack surface. A first-time commenter's submission is held for moderator approval, but once approved the stored payload executes for any user who clicks the image link.

CVE-2026-135668.text: The Advanced Form Integration — Connect Forms to 300+ Apps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'mapped CF7 fields (e.g. target, mkey, payload)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.11.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires an administrator to have pre-configured an AFI integration that maps all three ACF action slots (postId, selector, and value) to public form fields via the plugin's 'Use a form field…' option, which is a non-default configuration.

CVE-2026-136224.text: The Calculated Fields Form – AI Form Builder for WordPress – Contact, Payment, Quote, Quiz & More plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'x' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.6.0.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link. Exploitation requires the WordPress site to have a published form configured with a URL-backed text field (using the predefined url.x attribute) wired through a calculated-field equation that calls set_timeslots(); without this non-default form configuration, the vulnerable sink is unreachable.

CVE-2026-136519.text: The Advanced Product Fields (Product Addons) for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'wapf[field_ ]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload survives sanitization via a whitespace-prefixed tag gadget, is normalized into real HTML elements by wp_kses_post() and force_balance_tags() at render time, and is then executed by WordPress core's tags-box.js when it encounters the forged #tagsdiv-post_tag element on the order screen.

CVE-2026-136544.text: The Classified Listing – AI-Powered Classified ads & Business Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'formData[description]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload survives server-side sanitization because wp_kses_post permits span elements with class and data-* attributes; script execution is triggered only when a privileged user (Administrator or Editor) clicks the .reveal-phone span on the pending listing's preview page, causing rtcl-public.js to pass the attacker-controlled data-options value directly into jQuery.append. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

CVE-2026-133922.text: The WPFunnels – Funnel Builder for WooCommerce with Checkout & One Click Upsell plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to sensitive information disclosure in versions up to, and including, 3.13.8 This is due to the wpfnl_register_dashboard_widgets() function registering the 'WPFunnels Overview' dashboard widget on the wp_dashboard_setup hook with no capability check on either the registration or the wpfnl_dashboard_overview_widget() callback, which queries the wpfnl_stats and wpfnl_optin_entries tables and echoes the store's completed-order count, total revenue, order-bump revenue, upsell/downsell revenue and total lead/optin count directly into the dashboard. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above (contributor-level on sites running WooCommerce, where WC_Admin::prevent_admin_access() blocks subscribers from reaching /wp-admin/index.

CVE-2026-135267.text: The Relevanssi – A Better Search plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'name (REST /wp/v2/tags) / tax_input[post_tag] (post save)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.28.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable because WordPress's wp_filter_kses stores entity-encoded payloads (e.g., ) verbatim as literal text in the database, but Relevanssi's relevanssi_entity_decode() subsequently converts them into live HTML markup before the unescaped return branch of relevanssi_the_tags() splices them into the tag list consumed by the theme.

CVE-2026-135269.text: The WPC Linked Variation for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'wpclv_link[source]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.6.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-135620.text: The Relevanssi – A Better Search plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 4.28.9. CVE-2026-131806.text: The CubeWP Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'cwp_custom_form[form_data_id]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.13 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-130045.text: The WP Optin Wheel – Gamified Optin Email Marketing Tool for WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_fields[].value (XML-RPC wp.newPost -> post meta 'options' -> JSON->theme)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-130056.text: The W4 Post List plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (for metakeyinput= )' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-131688.text: The Secure MCP Server for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor and other AI Agents plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.8 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. CVE-2026-120570.text: The Enfold theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'templateName' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-122065.text: The MoreConvert Wishlist for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'empty_icon' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-123175.text: The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_text (shortcode attribute of [vc_cta])' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-125293.text: The WPMR Google Feed Manager for WooCommerce – Sell on Google Merchant Center & Shopping plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'feed (title field inside the JSON-encoded feed array)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.24.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. CVE-2026-119630.text: The Timetics – Appointment Booking Calendar & Scheduling System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data and user account creation in versions up to, and including, 1.0.67 This is due to the public `POST /wp-json/timetics/v1/bookings` route being registered with `permission_callback => function () { return true; }` and the handler (`create_item()` → `save_bookings()` → `booking_appointment()`) passing the attacker-controlled `email` directly into `Customer::make()`, which (a) grants the `timetics-customer` role to any existing WordPress user matched by email — including administrators and staff — and overwrites that account's `first_name`/`last_name` user meta, and (b) calls `wp_insert_user()` with role `timetics-customer` when the email is new, regardless of the site's `users_can_register` setting. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to create arbitrary WordPress user accounts, assign the `timetics-customer` role to existing accounts (including administrators), and overwrite their profile metadata.

CVE-2026-137035.text: A flaw was found in bootc. On a sealed composefs boot with a strict composefs digest on the kernel command line, the initramfs derives fs-verity enforcement from unsigned repository metadata and can mount an image under images/refs without measuring it against that digest. An attacker with offline write access to the root filesystem can boot a modified root under a legitimately signed UKI.

CVE-2026-137036.text: A flaw was found in bootc. On a sealed composefs boot, a failed bootc-root-setup.service does not fail initrd-root-fs.target, so the initramfs can switch root into the unverified physical root under the original signed UKI.

When the imuxsock module is configured with plain trusted-property annotation, it fails to properly escape process names and executable paths in log metadata. A local attacker can exploit this issue by sending log messages through the local log socket with crafted process names to inject forged identity attributes.

CVE-2026-133206.text: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an advertiser can put XML syntax in fields of its own video creative. Unescaped MediaFile attributes and CDATA terminators allow the advertiser to inject elements into VAST responses served for a publisher's zone. A crafted TrackingEvents block can suppress the ad server's video playback event records and redirect tracking requests to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

CVE-2026-133207.text: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, user-controlled entity names in XLS report exports can be interpreted as spreadsheet formulas. A user with permission to rename a zone can place a formula in the zone name, which is then included in another user's Conversion Tracking report. Opening the affected spreadsheet can evaluate the formula and alter displayed report contents.

CVE-2026-133208.text: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, unauthenticated request parameters in ad delivery can cause reflected cross-site scripting. A crafted delivery URL places a macro token in the source or target parameter and malicious markup in the referer parameter. Macro replacement after initial input encoding can insert the unescaped markup into generated banner output, causing JavaScript execution in the delivery origin when a visitor follows the URL. An active banner is required.

CVE-2026-133209.text: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, deleting an agency, advertiser, or publisher through affected API paths can leave the associated account and user session active because the deletion path does not load the entity's account identifier before cleanup. A user whose entity has been deleted can continue accessing pages of the orphaned account. Access to data belonging to another agency was not demonstrated.

CVE-2026-133210.text: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the zone banner-linking page (zone-include.php) does not cast the keys of the includebanner request array to integers. An authenticated manager, or a trafficker with the zone-linking permission, who owns the submitted website and zone can place SQL in an array key, which is concatenated unquoted into the banner-lookup query, resulting in time-based blind SQL injection bounded by the privileges of the application's database account.

CVE-2026-133211.text: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the ct0 request parameter of the delivery scripts is only required to start with http:// or https:// and is prepended unescaped to banner click URLs. An unauthenticated attacker can craft a delivery URL that executes JavaScript in the delivery origin when a visitor follows it. An active banner using the raw {clickurl} macro is required.

CVE-2026-133202.text: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an authenticated manager with access to two advertisers can associate a conversion tracker owned by one advertiser with a campaign owned by the other. The tracker-campaign page checks access to each object but does not verify that their actual owners match. The resulting association can expose the first advertiser's tracker name and identifier in the second advertiser's restricted conversion report.

CVE-2026-133203.text: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the public conversion-variable endpoint does not verify that a caller-supplied conversion belongs to the supplied tracker. An unauthenticated attacker can submit a unique variable for a different tracker's conversion, causing that conversion to be classified as a duplicate and excluded from conversion reports.

CVE-2026-133204.text: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the zone-linking page can disclose campaign and banner names and identifiers belonging to another agency. An authenticated manager, or a website user with permission to link banners to zones, can supply another agency's advertiser and campaign identifiers because the selection lists are not restricted to the agency owning the zone.

CVE-2026-133205.text: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an authenticated manager can supply another agency's advertiser or website identifier as a report scope and obtain that entity's name in an XLS report header. Submitted scope identifiers are not checked against the manager's permitted selections. The demonstrated disclosure is limited to entity names.

The affected element is the function setLanguageCfg of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi. Such manipulation of the argument lang leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

CVE-2026-137046.text: A vulnerability was detected in mahmoudai1 school-management-system up to ecec9faaf2fb1a3c5cd096e063f8ef326d09cdfd. The impacted element is the function userModel::checkUserInDB of the file loginServer.php of the component Login Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument ID results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-137326.text: ICU4C through 79.1 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in the x11-compound-text converter because cloning shares the extraInfo block without a safeClone handler. Attackers who control the charset name passed to ucnv_open() in applications calling ucnv_setSubstString() or cloning converters can corrupt the heap, causing crashes and potentially code execution.

CVE-2026-137327.text: GNU mtools through 4.0.50 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability that allows attackers to crash mtools commands by supplying a FAT image with a zero sectors-per-cluster byte. Attackers can craft a FAT image that, when opened with mdir, minfo or mtype, triggers a SIGFPE in calc_num_clus() on x86, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-136991.text: A weakness has been identified in Spotweb up to 1.5.8. This issue affects the function redirect of the file lib/SpotTemplateHelper.php of the component Login. Executing a manipulation of the argument http_referer can lead to open redirect. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. This patch is called 0853d646d615225b35f466a960976d1492b786a9. Applying a patch is advised to resolve this issue.

CVE-2026-123682.text: An authenticated remote code execution vulnerability exists in the update functionality of StellarOne due to insufficient validation of files contained within uploaded update packages. An attacker with web administrator privileges can upload a crafted update package to execute arbitrary programs with root privileges on the server. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

CVE-2026-123683.text: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in an Accounts Manager service of StellarOne running inside a container due to improper handling of user-supplied input in SQL queries. An attacker with command execution access to the host system or another container with network connectivity to the affected service can send crafted requests to manipulate backend database queries. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

CVE-2026-123684.text: An improper version validation vulnerability exists in the product update mechanism of StellarProtect Linux and Stellar Agent (Linux). An attacker with product admin privileges can downgrade the product to an older, potentially vulnerable version, potentially allowing previously patched vulnerabilities to be reintroduced and security protections to be weakened. This issue affects StellarProtect Linux: 1.0 and earlier; Stellar Agent (Linux): before 1.2.54. *Note: Stellar Agent (Linux) is the new name for StellarProtect Linux.

CVE-2026-123685.text: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the patch apply functionality of StellarProtect Linux and Stellar Agent (Linux) due to insufficient validation of uploaded patch packages before extraction. An attacker with low-privileged web access can upload a crafted patch package to execute arbitrary programs with root privileges on the server. This issue affects StellarProtect Linux: 1.0 and earlier; Stellar Agent (Linux): before 1.2.54. *Note: Stellar Agent (Linux) is the new name for StellarProtect Linux.

CVE-2026-123686.text: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the vShell command-line interface of StellarOne due to improper validation of user-supplied input. An authenticated attacker with access to vShell can inject crafted commands to bypass the restricted shell environment and execute arbitrary operating system commands. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

CVE-2026-123687.text: An arbitrary file write vulnerability exists in the patch upload functionality of StellarOne due to improper validation of file paths. An attacker with admin web access can upload a crafted patch package to write arbitrary files on endpoints with the privileges of the endpoint service. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

CVE-2026-123680.text: An authenticated remote code execution vulnerability exists in the firmware update functionality of StellarOne. An attacker with admin privileges can upload a crafted firmware package to execute arbitrary programs with root privileges on the system. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

CVE-2026-123681.text: An HTML injection vulnerability exists in the alert notification functionality of StellarOne due to improper sanitization of agent-supplied data. An attacker controlling an agent identity can submit crafted HTML content, potentially allowing the attacker to manipulate displayed content or deceive recipients. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

CVE-2026-123679.text: An improper access control vulnerability exists in a privileged Unix domain socket of StellarProtect Linux and Stellar Agent (Linux). Due to insufficient authorization checks, a low-privileged local attacker can interact with the daemon and invoke privileged operations without the necessary permissions. This issue affects StellarProtect Linux: 1.0 and earlier; Stellar Agent (Linux): before 1.2.54. *Note: Stellar Agent (Linux) is the new name for StellarProtect Linux.

CVE-2026-136990.text: A vulnerability has been found in TAILG Feimeng up to 20261028. Affected is an unknown function of the component Wireless Remote Control System. The manipulation leads to authentication bypass by capture-replay. The attack needs to be initiated within the local network. The attack is considered to have high complexity. The exploitability is told to be difficult. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-137305.text: Grav Form plugin before 9.2.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows page authors to write uploads into Twig template folders by setting an unchecked file field destination in Form::uploadFiles(). Attackers can upload .txt or .svg files containing Twig and have them rendered as trusted templates outside the sandbox, executing code as the web server user.

CVE-2026-137306.text: Grav Admin plugin before 1.10.65 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability in LoginController::taskForgot() that ignores the Require Trusted Host setting when building reset links. Unauthenticated attackers who know an administrator's username can submit the forgot-password form with a forged Host header, capturing the reset token when clicked to take over accounts.

CVE-2026-137307.text: wpa_supplicant 2.7 through 2.12 with the wolfSSL backend contains an EAP-FAST server authentication bypass in tls_sess_sec_cb() that skips master secret derivation for oversized PAC-Opaque tickets. Adjacent attackers running a rogue authenticator can complete the handshake with an all-zero master secret to capture MS-CHAPv2 responses for offline cracking and replace the stored PAC.

CVE-2026-136795.text: Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via unbounded inflation of zip DEF payloads. When a token header sets "zip" to "DEF", decode_jwt inflates the payload with no limit on the output size. A signed token is inflated after its signature verifies. An encrypted token is inflated after decryption, and with RSA-OAEP or ECDH-ES key management anyone who holds the recipient's public key can produce a token that decrypts.

CVE-2026-136796.text: Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via an unbounded PBES2 iteration count. For a token using a PBES2 key management algorithm, decode_jwt passes the p2c header parameter to PBKDF2 as the iteration count without a range check, and derives the key before any integrity check. Unless accepted_alg rules it out, a token can select PBES2 whenever decode_jwt is given a symmetric key.

CVE-2026-136510.text: A parameter-array execution that fails part-way leaves the rows it has already queued on the statement handle, and the next execution on that handle sends them. After a data-at-execution batch is abandoned, by SQLCancel or a rejected SQLPutData, the next SQLExecDirect sends the failed batch's rows and returns SQL_SUCCESS without sending its own statement. So an application that logs the failure on the same handle has its log entry turned into a silent no-op, while rows it was told had failed are stored. An end user who controls one value in an application's array insert can arrange both halves of that. A second route needs no data-at-execution parameter: when building a later row fails in parameter conversion, the queued rows go to the server ahead of the next parameter array on the handle, inside whatever transaction and session settings are current by then. One variant also writes past the end of a shorter SQL_ATTR_PARAM_STATUS_PTR array supplied by the next statement. The statements that run are the application's own, correctly quoted; no SQL text comes from outside. CVE-2026-136504.text: With the driver's debug log (MyLog) turned on, two paths write the database password to the log in clear text, both beside a line where the driver's own redaction masks it as PWD=xxxxx: - Pressing "Test" in the Windows data source setup dialog (psqlsetup.dll) logs the whole connection string, which carries PWD= percent-encoded, which is reversible, and any password= or sslpassword= inside pqopt. - The Unicode connect functions SQLDriverConnectW, SQLConnectW and SQLBrowseConnectW log their arguments as they convert them between UTF-16 and UTF-8, before the masking happens. The ANSI entry points are unaffected. Turning the log on takes an administrator, and MyLog is off by default. The exposure is the person who later reads the log, which in practice means a log attached to a bug report or handed to support. Making that safe is the purpose of the driver's redaction, and these two sites bypassed it. Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

CVE-2026-136506.text: psqlODBC builds queries of its own from names, and put these names into them without escaping or qualification: - the database name in SQLForeignKeys(); - the current schema name in catalog functions; - the table name in the currtid2() call that re-reads rows of updatable cursors; - column names in the inserts and updates of SQLSetPos() and SQLBulkOperations(); - cursor names set with SQLSetCursorName() or returned as refcursors (FetchRefcursors=1); - parameter names (SQL_DESC_NAME) in procedure calls; - the = operator in an OID comparison in SQLColumns(), which the server resolves through search_path. CVE-2026-136507.text: psqlODBC parsed and built connection strings in ways that let a value end early: - In a braced value, such as PWD={…}, a trailing byte 0x7d of a GBK, Big5 or SJIS character was taken for the closing brace. - A braced value that ended right after an escaped }} was not reported as unterminated, and its contents were parsed as further keywords. - SQLConnectW(), SQLDriverConnectW() and SQLBrowseConnectW() cut a connection string whose UTF-8 form is longer than 32767 bytes, which changes how the rest of it is parsed. - On Windows with MSDTC, the password and user name were put into the XA open string without escaping, and the XA library copied each item of that string into a 64-byte stack buffer. - Percent-encoding a long password wrote one byte past a 4096-byte stack buffer. An end user who supplies a password, or another value the application puts into the connection string, can set other connection keywords, for example to connect the application to a server of their choosing. CVE-2026-136508.text: On Windows, when a connection takes part in a distributed transaction, psqlODBC and its XA library open further connections of their own to finish the transaction. These connections did not keep the security settings of the application's connection: - When the XA library's first connection attempt failed, it tried again with sslmode=allow, even for a data source configured with sslmode=verify-full or verify-ca. - The connections the driver opens itself ignored every libpq option given through pqopt, such as channel_binding=require, and the open string it registers with MSDTC carried no pqopt, so the XA library's connections dropped those options too. An attacker on the network path between the MSDTC host and the PostgreSQL server, without a certificate or credentials, can make those connections go to a server of their choosing without TLS, read and change what they send, and decide the outcome MSDTC records for the transaction. Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

CVE-2026-136500.text: To escape a bound parameter, or a name passed to a catalog function, psqlODBC has to know where each multibyte character of the client encoding ends. It treated a client encoding named by an alias the server accepts, such as WIN950, Windows950 or big-5 for BIG5, as single-byte, and it accepted too narrow a range of lead bytes for JOHAB, EUC_TW, EUC_CN and EUC_KR. A quote byte that the server reads as part of such a character was then not doubled, or a quote the server reads on its own was taken for part of a character, and the literal ended early. An end user who controls one bound character parameter, or a name the application passes to a catalog function such as SQLTables(), can run SQL with the rights of the application's database role. This requires a connection that is not in UTF-8: the ANSI driver, or the ANSI entry points, with one of these client encodings. CVE-2026-82490.text: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the OpenSearch reporting dashboard proxy, where the nginx auth_request only verifies login status without checking the declared right before attaching a hardcoded administrative credential to the proxied request, and the backend OpenSearch cluster has its security plugin disabled via a hardcoded compose setting. CVE-2026-82491.text: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the core export mixin (openimis-be-core_py, core/gql/export_mixin.py) that allows authenticated users with a single ordinary read right to traverse arbitrary foreign key relations by supplying caller-controlled dotted field paths that are rewritten into Django ORM syntax without an allow-list. Attackers can exploit this to export another user's JWT signing key via a path such as user_created.i_user.private_key, enabling them to forge valid authenticated sessions for other accounts, including administrators, without detection through failed-login events or invalidation by password reset.

CVE-2026-82492.text: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an improper validation vulnerability in the deduplication service (openimis-be-deduplication_py, deduplication/services.py) that allows a caller holding only the narrow right 170001 to bypass column path validation by exploiting the fact that only the first segment of a dotted relation path is checked before the full unvalidated path is used in the query. Attackers can supply a crafted dotted column path such as user_created__i_user__private_key to traverse relations and retrieve an administrator's JWT signing key, enabling forgery of a valid administrator session without a password that survives password resets and generates no failed-login event.

CVE-2026-82493.text: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the report module's overrideReport GraphQL mutation, which stores submitted report definitions without proper validation before rendering them with the simpleeval expression evaluator. An attacker holding only limited report add, edit, or query privileges can craft a printIf expression that leverages the datetime module to reach os.system functions, bypassing the name-prefix blocklist to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root whenever the malicious report is later rendered by any viewer, including administrators or scheduled jobs.

CVE-2026-82494.text: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the FHIR R4 module (openimis-be-api_fhir_r4_py) that allows an authenticated attacker with limited district-level access to receive subscription notifications for data outside their authorized scope due to the absence of row-level security checks such as has_perms, get_queryset, ROW_SECURITY, district, or health-facility scoping on the notification delivery path. Attackers can register a standing FHIR subscription to continuously receive claim data and can further direct notification pushes to internal network addresses.

CVE-2026-82495.text: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a broken access control vulnerability in the FHIR R4 module that allows any authenticated attacker to delete Coverage policy records due to an empty permissions_delete list being vacuously granted by user.has_perms([]). CVE-2026-136919.text: FCEUX 2.5.0 before 2.8.0 contains an integer overflow in iNESLoad() in src/ines.cpp that allows a crafted NES 2.0 ROM to write past a heap buffer.
